Ghost formulas removed: seven sheets carried about 1,238,318 formulas and formats out to column XFD (the sheet edge), far beyond the 84-column timeline (J to CO). Trimming them cuts the file from about 6.0 MB to 0.4 MB and makes recalculation take seconds instead of many minutes. The unused scratch sheet 'Temp' (about 50,000 formulas) was removed.

Defined names LIVE_RESULTS, TRACK_ACTIVE and TRK_COMMENT repaired (they pointed at deleted cells); name 'unit' re-pointed from an external link to InpC!F102; sheet-level names on Track that pointed at an external workbook removed; Time print area extended to column CO; external link removed.
Typos corrected: Scenario, arrival, Investment, Accounting, available, period, NPV of ...
Stray zeros removed (Tax C28, C35; InpC row 45; InpS J74).
Total and check ranges extended to column CO (they stopped at BY, BV or CQ): the three FinStat checks now cover every column, Time!H79 now counts the post-forecast flag.

Scenarios made coherent: Upside was worse than Base (2% flat inflation) and Downside equalled Base. Now Base / Downside (fare -10%, O&M +10%) / Upside (fare +10%). O&M sensitivity input (InpC row 46) is now live.
Tax: interest deduction placeholder completed (Tax row 26 = Debt interest). Cash tax now deducts interest, so deferred tax unwinds to zero and nothing is left stranded in retained earnings.

Day count corrected: Time row 30 (days in model period) was period end less period beginning, one day short in every quarter (a 361-day year; Constr already used true days). It is now end less beginning plus 1. Interest, receivables and payables, and every result that depends on them move slightly (for example the start-model NPV by about 0.4%).

Placeholders completed: Debt row 42 and Equity row 22 now take inputs from InpS rows 22 and 23; they flow through the cash cascade (FinStat rows 39 and 43) and the shareholder valuation (Val rows 24 and 27).
FinStat: DSCR block added: debt service, DSCR, minimum, average and whole-life cover.
Calculation mode: the workbook was saved in MANUAL calculation mode, so results stayed stale after switching scenario until F9 was pressed. It is now saved in Automatic mode.
